topic: Yellow and Blue Sticky Traps Function

options.text: Both traps catch only stray domestic cattle

detailedSolution:

Insects exhibit positive phototaxis to specific wavelengths: yellow attracts aphids and whiteflies, while blue attracts flower thrips, trapping them on sticky glue.

questionText:
Arrange the traditional steps for preparing 200 liters of liquid Jiwamrita (enough for one acre of natural farming):
(I) Mix 10 kg of fresh Desi cow dung with 10 liters of Desi cow urine in a 200-liter plastic drum
(II) Add 2 kg of organic jaggery (or sugarcane juice) and 2 kg of pulse flour (besan) along with a handful of virgin forest soil
(III) Fill the barrel with 200 liters of chemical-free water and stir vigorously clockwise with a wooden stick

topic: Process of Preparing Farm-Brewed Jiwamrita Inoculant
questionText:
Arrange the traditional steps for preparing 200 liters of liquid Jiwamrita (enough for one acre of natural farming):
(I) Mix 10 kg of fresh Desi cow dung with 10 liters of Desi cow urine in a 200-liter plastic drum
(II) Add 2 kg of organic jaggery (or sugarcane juice) and 2 kg of pulse flour (besan) along with a handful of virgin forest soil
(III) Fill the barrel with 200 liters of chemical-free water and stir vigorously clockwise with a wooden stick
(IV) Keep the drum in shade covered with a moist gunny bag, stirring twice daily for 48 to 72 hours until microbial fermentation peaks

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: II -> I -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: IV -> II -> III -> I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: I -> III -> II -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: I -> II -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Jiwamrita preparation: blend dung/urine, add jaggery/besan/virgin soil, dilute with 200L water, and ferment in shade for 2–3 days.
Hence, Option C is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText: The 'Jaivik Bharat' certification logo introduced by FSSAI on organic food packaging in India signifies that the product:

options.text: Complies strictly with certified organic food standards under the National Programme for Organic Production

topic: High-Yielding Varieties (HYVs) Requirements
questionText:

Statement I: The high-yielding dwarf varieties (HYVs) of wheat and rice introduced during the Green Revolution were highly responsive to synthetic chemical fertilizers.
Statement II: To achieve their genetic yield potential, HYVs required an input-intensive package of chemical NPK fertilizers, heavy canal/tube-well irrigation, and chemical pesticides.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect

detailedSolution:

topic: Biocontrol Agents and Target Agricultural Pests
questionText:
Match the beneficial biocontrol organism in List I with its target pest in List II:

List I:
(A) Trichogramma chilonis (Egg Parasitoid Wasp)
(B) Coccinella septempunctata (Ladybird Beetle)
(C) Chrysoperla carnea (Green Lacewing)
(D) Beauveria bassiana (Entomopathogenic Fungus)

List II:
(I) Lepidopteran borers and bollworms (Helicoverpa, Chilo)
(II) Soft-bodied sap-sucking Aphids and Scale insects
(III) Whiteflies, Jassids, and Thrips
(IV) Soil white grubs, Caterpillars, and Termites

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Biocontrol Agents and Target Agricultural Pests.

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Sustainable Agriculture in India (Biocontrol Agents and Target Agricultural Pests):
A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV

Detailed Analysis:
Trichogramma parasitizes moth eggs, Ladybird beetles prey on aphids, Lacewings devour whiteflies, and Beauveria infects insect cuticles as a fungal pathogen.
Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.

topic: Non-Chemical Pest Control Tactics and Examples
questionText:
Match the non-chemical pest management method in List I with its operational example in List II:

List I:
(A) Cultural Control
(B) Mechanical / Physical Control
(C) Biological Control
(D) Behavioral / Semiochemical Control

List II:
(I) Crop rotation, adjusting sowing dates to escape pest peaks, and deep summer plowing to expose pupae
(II) Hand-picking large caterpillars, installing bird perches, and bagging fruit clusters with paper
(III) Conserving predatory ladybird beetles, lacewings, and releasing Trichogramma wasps
(IV) Installing synthetic sex pheromone delta traps and light traps in fields

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II

detailedSolution:
